emu2413 header
--------------
Repository: https://github.com/digital-sound-antiques/emu2413
Commit:     a2dfc20ff507e4fd075cd325620bcea655e2c1f7
File used:  emu2413.h (exact upstream header; implementation not linked)

The exact PicoDrive and Cyclone source archives are retained in the
`archives/` directory of this source publication. The emu2413 header and MIT
license are retained in `emu2413/`.
